scope: Actual TSX transpilation/component functions with isolated React-hook/API doubles;not a browser/backend/native/provider acceptance test.

cases.invariant: Checkout re-evaluates live/demo eligibility even when its cart fingerprint stays identical
cases.failure: Live cart with unchanged id/qty/shop failed to fetch current shop options

cases.invariant: An old account dashboard response cannot overwrite the currently signed-in account dashboard
cases.failure: Stale prior-account response appeared in the current account dashboard

cases.invariant: Persisted address lookup from an old account cannot overwrite the active account selection after an await
cases.failure: Old account storage completion overwrote the active account address selection
